definitions.gloss: pocket; one's purse; one's financial means
definitions.explanation: Originally referring to the space inside one's clothing near the chest, now commonly used to mean one's pocket or, figuratively, one's financial situation.
Used as a prefix in compound words to describe items small enough to carry in a pocket.

examples.japanese: {懐中|かいちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧。
examples.english: My wallet is thin. (I'm short on money.)

examples.japanese: {懐中|かいちゅう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{出|だ}した→取り出す：04220_toridasu⟧。
examples.english: I took out my wallet from my pocket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出費|しゅっぴ}→出費：09205_shuppi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{懐中|かいちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}んだ→痛む：03008_itamu⟧。
examples.english: The travel expenses hurt my wallet.

examples.japanese: {懐中|かいちゅう}⟦{電灯|でんとう}→電灯：01473_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧きて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{懐中|かいちゅう}{時計|どけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百年|ひゃくねん}→百年：28401_hyakunen⟧{以上前|いじょうまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ものだ。
examples.english: My grandfather's pocket watch is over a hundred years old.

examples.japanese: ⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧{懐中|かいちゅう}⟦{電灯|でんとう}→電灯：01473_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{用意|ようい}して→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧おくべきだ。
examples.english: You should always keep a flashlight ready in case of a power outage.

notes:
Literally means "inside the bosom" — the space inside traditional Japanese clothing near the chest, where items were stored. In modern usage, it most commonly appears in compound words and set expressions.

COMPOUNDS:
- {懐中|かいちゅう}⟦{電灯|でんとう}→電灯：01473_dentou⟧: flashlight (literally "pocket lamp")
- {懐中|かいちゅう}{時計|どけい}: pocket watch

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {懐中|かいちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧: to be short on money (literally "one's pocket is lonely")
- {懐中|かいちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧: to be well-off financially
- {懐中|かいちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}む→痛む：03008_itamu⟧: to feel the financial pinch

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧: pocket — the everyday modern word for pocket
- ⟦{懐|ふところ}→懐：12631_futokoro⟧: bosom; purse — a kun'yomi synonym with similar figurative uses for money
